Subject: AvBank MAP: security checklist, SOC 2 evidence & DPA redline

Hi Sara —

Thanks again for the demo last week. As discussed, we want to put the Mutual Action Plan (MAP) milestones in writing so procurement and security have a clear close path. For AvBank the main open security gates we heard are: SOC 2 evidence, SIG/CAIQ responses, signed DPA with a small retention carveout, and confirmation of data residency/retention windows.

Quick asks to get the MAP moving:
- Can you confirm the procurement target sign date youre planning for? (approx month/quarter)
- Preferred data retention window: 90 / 365 / 730 days?
- Any mandatory CAIQ sections you want prioritized (e.g., key management, logging, incident response)?

Ill coordinate internally to assemble a package: our latest SOC 2 report (point-in-time), a filled CAIQ matrix, and an initial DPA redline for your legal team to review. Kimberly from Security will lead the evidence intake — looping her in. Marissa will own commercial/closing cadence.

Proposed short MAP (high level):
1) Evidence handoff (SOC 2 + CAIQ) — by 9/16
2) DPA redline submitted — by 9/17
3) Security Q&A & 1-hr walkthrough — target week of 9/20
4) Mutual sign & PO — target 9/30

If that looks reasonable Ill drop the formal MAP doc and a calendar invite for a walkthrough.

Thanks,
Jordan Blake
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
[jordan@redwood.com]

Attachments: none in this initial note

From: Sara Patel <sara.patel@avbank.com>

Date: Wed, 15 Sep 2026 11:12:00 -0400
Subject: Re: AvBank MAP: security checklist, SOC 2 evidence & DPA redline

Jordan —

Appreciate the plan. Procurement is targeting end of September but we can accelerate to mid-September if security signoff is clean. A few clarifications from our side:

- Retention: default preference is 365 days; in some regulated flows we might need 730 days but start with 365 as baseline.
- CAIQ: priority on key management (KMS/HSM), access control/SCIM, and logging/retention. Can you supply the CAIQ responses scoped to our account?
- SOC 2: we need the most recent Type II covering the period through at least May 2026.
- DPA: our legal will redline, but it'd be faster if you share an initial redline version highlighting: subprocessing, cross-border, and a proposed 365-day retention clause.

Procurement copied here — they will attach our standard procurement questionnaire once we have your SOC 2 and CAIQ packet.

Thanks,
Sara Patel
Head of Vendor Risk | Avery Bank
Sara.Patel@avbank.com

Hi team —

Looping in a narrow security plan and what well hand off. Summary of what we can deliver and timing:

Deliverables (initial):
- SOC 2 Type II (report stub) covering controls through 2026-05 — delivered as a redacted PDF by 2026-09-16.
- Completed CAIQ responses (account-scoped) — spreadsheet with our answers and references to control owners by 2026-09-16.
- DPA redline (our suggested concessions and retention language) — Word doc by 2026-09-17.

Security notes / options for AvBank MAP:
- Data residency: hosted (multi-region) by default; for EU-only or on-prem we can propose Private deployment. For AvBank US traffic we can commit to US regions and provide an IP/CIDR list for routing.
- Retention windows: we propose 3 standard profiles you can choose from: 90 days (default cache + logs), 365 days (default for regulated flows), 730 days (extended archival). Each has a small cost delta; we can put exact delta in the MAP.
- Key management: we support customer-managed keys (KMS) integrations + HSM signing for private deployments; CAIQ will map which controls are supported by our KMS integrations.
- Incident response & tracing: we will provide playbook excerpts and a contact escalation matrix for the walkthrough.

MAP sequencing suggestion (security-critical path highlighted):
1) Evidence packet (SOC2 + CAIQ) — 9/16 (deliver)
2) Legal review of DPA redline — 9/17 to 9/20
3) Security walkthrough & clarifications — schedule 60 minutes (target 9/21)
4) Final legal/DPA signoff & procurement PO — target week of 9/27

If procurement needs a faster lane we can compress steps 2-3 in the same day. Ill attach the stub files in the handoff email.

-Kimberly
